title: Untitled Discourses on Ten to Forty Qualities (1st)
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 10 Numbered Discourses 10.225–228
  • 22. Sāmaññavagga 22. Similarity

~ Untitled Discourses on Ten to Forty Qualities (1st)

“Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato khataṁ upahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati …pe… “Someone with ten qualities keeps themselves broken and damaged … akkhataṁ anupahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati …pe… keeps themselves intact and unscathed … vīsatiyā, bhikkhave …pe… twenty … tiṁsāya, bhikkhave …pe… thirty … cattārīsāya, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato khataṁ upahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati …pe…. forty …”

(…)
